description: This file implements the backend logic for the LinearPlaybackControl plugin, including RPC property handlers, demuxer interaction, and notifications for a media playback control system within the WPEFramework. It handles properties like channel, seek, trickplay, status, and tracing, providing getter and setter functions, and contains internal helper functions and registration routines.

classes.name: LinearPlaybackControl
classes.description: Class that manages the JSON-RPC properties and interactions for linear playback, including channel selection, seeking, trickplay, status updates, and tracing controls.

methods.name: callDemuxer
methods.description: Invokes a provided function on the demuxer instance, used for executing property-specific actions.

methods.name: speedchangedNotify
methods.description: Notifies about speed change events to registered observers.
